deploy-bot: Deploy queued but throttled — semaphore limit reached for production (active=5, limit=4). Request: service/payments @maya tag=v2.8.1-hotfix commit=abc1234 env=production. Expected duration ~6m. See CI: https://ci.redwood/12345 :warning:
maya: Ugh, hotfix for payment double-charge. Can we bump priority?
oliver: What else is in the queue? Any non-critical jobs we can cancel to free a slot?
sanjay: I see three low-priority feature deploys and one db-migrations job. migrations are scheduled in change window at 02:00 UTC; not safe to cancel.
esther: If we pin this hotfix to a dedicated slot, can we reserve capacity? We have a pinning mechanism but needs manual approval.
maya: I'll take ownership of approval if that helps. This fix blocks a customer incident.
deploy-bot: Pin request registered. Current queue snapshot: [payments-hotfix (urgent), feat/ux-142 (low), feat/search-cache (low), db/migration-2026-03-20 (sched), analytics-rollout (low)]. Semaphore prevents preemptive kill of running deploys.
oliver: Can we preempt analytics-rollout? It's okay to cancel that one.
sanjay: Analytics was at 10% rollout, safe to abort and requeue.
maya: Approving pin — please preempt analytics and promote payments-hotfix. @esther can you sign off on the change window delta?
esther: Sign-off: change window unaffected (hotfix is <10min and doesn't touch migrations). :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Analytics deploy canceled by system (id=789). Slot freed. Payments-hotfix moved to active queue position 3 -> starting shortly.
oncall-bot: Reminder: post-mortem trigger threshold met? incident severity=pager; consult oncall if deploy fails.
maya: I'll monitor. If anything flaky, we'll rollback to tag=v2.8.0 (commit=def5678).
oliver: Quick note — add to release notes: "Fix double-charge on retry path (hotfix)" and call out rollback tag.
sanjay: Also add a changelog entry and mark customer-impact in notes so CS can notify.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: payments service @ production tag=v2.8.1-hotfix commit=abc1234 started_by=maya worker=eu-west-1a run_id=deploy-1782001123-01. Stream: https://deploy.redwood/streams/deploy-1782001123
maya: Monitoring logs. No immediate errors. :eyes:
deploy-bot: Health checks passed at +45s. Serving traffic at 25%.
oncall-bot: Auto-notify: oncall@sre (sanjay) — if error rate spikes >2% for 5m, escalation will trigger.
esther: Great — backing out only if we see charge rates spike. maya keep me looped.
maya: Not seeing anomalies but will keep a 15m watch.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished successfully at +4m20s. Release tag v2.8.1-hotfix -> production.
maya: Nice. Adding release notes and pinging CS.
oliver: Thanks team. Marking analytics deploy to be requeued later.
sanjay: Requeue analytics for 03:30 UTC.
maya: Closing thread — :tada: Good job everyone.
